segments.Essendo presente in questo libro, non h: Being featured in this book, I couldn't help taking part in its launch as well. Anna and I lived together for a couple of years in remote German-speaking Switzerland, in St. Gallen, where the true story behind this book was born.
segments.In occasione del lancio di ”La vergogna: For the launch of ”La vergogna di un Bournout”, Anna wanted a few shots: a series of studio portraits from which to choose the book cover, and a nature-connection themed series that would convey the concept behind it in a more emotional way. The book is a novel about a girl who, after suffering the consequences of a path made of professional milestones, goals, expectations and pressure constantly at the limit, falls into an existential crisis and, questioning who she really is and what truly matters to her, begins a joyful journey of self-rediscovery.
segments.Proprio perché stare in contatto con la: Precisely because being in contact with nature is an important gesture that brings a person back to themselves — just like reading — we decided to portray an ordinary girl in the act of reading the story immersed in greenery, with bare feet touching the earth.
segments.Leggere un libro in un bosco, sdraiati s: Reading a book in a wood, lying on a meadow or leaning against a tree trunk undoubtedly makes reading a light, flavourful and memorable experience.

segments.Conosco Enrico da alcuni anni ormai, ed: I've known Enrico for a few years now, and he has always been a delightful person — playful, full of energy, a real joy to be around. Keeping up with him isn't easy; you can find him anywhere with his dog, Muffin, and then watch him vanish as if he were made of air. He asked me to take some photos with Muffin, so he'd have a lasting memory of his dog, as clumsy as he is affectionate and adorable.
segments.Vista la fine dell’estate e il meteo per: With summer ending and the weather perfect for anything, we decided to take advantage of the sunset colours in Tirrenia and its wide beaches, empty at the end of the season. Muffin ventured out cautiously at first, but was quickly swept up, poor thing, by our enthusiasm for some action shots. We came up with every excuse to make him run back and forth, and the shoot got off to a great start.
segments.Enrico, che non si tira mai indietro dav: Enrico, who never backs down from a challenge, warmed up with a few running shots that would have impressed even Bolt. Then he decided to dive into the water with his trusty steed — er, dog. Not wanting to be outdone (and still behind on my yearly swim count), I dived in too to capture their emotions up close.
segments.Ci siamo lasciati trasportare dalle onde: We let ourselves be carried by the waves, the gentle currents and the unhurried flow of time, while I shot away at my subjects. When we finally declared ourselves satisfied with the result, covered in sand and water, we dried off on the shore and ran to the nearest fast food joint. Here is a selection of shots from that day.
segments.) si trovano incastonate tra le Alpi Apu: ) are nestled in the Apuan Alps, about 100 km from my home. Famous for their prized marble, they have been exporting these precious stones all over the world for centuries. Beyond their commercial importance, the quarries hold an almost otherworldly charm, hidden among the peaks of the Apuan Alps and overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea by Forte dei Marmi.
segments.Non essendoci mai stato prima, ho colto: Having never been there before, I took the opportunity to portray Rebecca in this unexplored place. The most adventurous and demanding part of our journey was tackling the steep, dangerous mountain roads, still scarred by recent landslides. One of the most daunting obstacles was a huge chasm in the asphalt, caused by a falling boulder, which momentarily blocked our way. Luckily we managed to find an alternative route and continued the climb.
segments.Superate le prime difficoltà, ci siamo r: Once past the first difficulties, we found ourselves immersed in an almost metaphysical landscape. The autumn tones of the surrounding trees gradually gave way to white, as the snow began to cover everything with its immaculate blanket. This pristine canvas was enriched by the varied shades of the different extraction basins: the tones of the marble shone and shifted under the light of the grey sky, filtered by a thin, suspended mist.
segments.Una cava in particolare, abbagliante nel: One quarry in particular, dazzling in its luminous intensity, unfortunately remained inaccessible to us. So we opted for a site with darker tones, set in breathtaking scenery. As we made our way among the rocks, threads of mist rose around us, wrapping the mountain peaks towering above our heads. Although the icy wind urged us to seek shelter, we spent hours immersed in that magnetic landscape, capturing the grandeur of the marble slabs, carved vertically by black veins, and the wide artificial terraces overlooking unspoilt nature.

segments.Rildson ed io siamo amici da tredici ann: Rildson and I have been friends for thirteen years, ever since he arrived in Italy from Brazil to teach and spread Brazilian Capoeira.
segments.È una persona molto allegra e scherzosa,: He is a very cheerful, playful person who can never sit still and can't help coming up with something original. He has countless talents: from martial arts to music, writing and so on…
segments.Da qualche anno porta avanti un progetto: For a few years now he has been working on a sculpture project, always tied to his homeland, but also to all his passions.
segments.Con il filo di ferro, arrugginito o meno: With iron wire, rusty or not — the humblest material he could find, recycled of course — he tells of slavery, music, struggle, dreams, play, but also of the world and social awareness.
segments.Trascorre molte ore a dare vita alle sue: He spends many hours bringing his statues to life: some are meant for adults, others for children, some for poets and others for lovers.
segments.Abbiamo deciso di fotografarle nel luogo: We decided to photograph them in the place Rildson loves most: the sea, which also gives meaning to the rust of his wires.
segments.Sebbene sia un luogo magico, ricco di sf: Although it is a magical place, rich in shades and colours, it is not at all easy to keep the sculptures standing.
segments.Per questo motivo abbiamo dovuto immerge: That's why we had to wade waist-deep into the “refreshing” winter sea.
segments.Ovviamente non è bastato: abbiamo dovuto: Of course that wasn't enough: we also had to find other solutions, under the astonished gazes of curious passers-by.
segments.Abbiamo riempito i basamenti con pietre: We filled the bases with stones gathered from the seabed and, with every shot, we fought against the waves to keep the statues balanced.

segments.J & A hanno deciso di celebrare il loro: J & A decided to celebrate their engagement with a trip to Europe. They set off from the United States and stopped in Italy, visiting some of the most beautiful cultural cities in the world such as Rome, Florence and Venice. On their romantic journey they also crossed Tuscany, where I had the pleasure and honour of photographing them in a village that, in summer, offers wonderful views with orange sunsets painting the rolling wheat hills that characterise the area.
segments.Cipressi, borghi medievali, buon cibo e: Cypresses, medieval villages, good food and excellent wine are among the main attractions for visitors, and right in Castelfalfi there is a resort of excellence that welcomes people from all over the world. The future spouses and I arranged a photographic tour through these places on a midsummer day. Our first stop was at David Tremlett's curious coloured houses in Ghizzano, where I also took wide-angle shots to tell the story of the whole medieval village, which welcomed the couple with its beauty of narrow alleys and stone walls.
segments.Abbiamo passeggiato tra piante fiorite,: We strolled among flowering plants, friendly characters and curious cats between the coloured walls.
segments.Dopo una breve pausa ci siamo spostati s: After a short break we moved to the top of a hill, bare and treeless, dominated by the ruins of an old farmhouse. Here, at 360 degrees, the golden wheat hills stretched to the horizon, making us feel alone in this paradise.
segments.Proprio per questa vista così particolar: Precisely because of this special view we decided to make drone footage and shots as well, before focusing on the couple's emotion, trying to make the most of the light and the soft slopes of the landscape.
segments.La prossima tappa è stata il giardino de: The next stop was the village garden which, although not very large, is well kept, elegant and in a strategic position for taking photographs in an intimate, sheltered space, just a few steps from the town centre. Here the light filters through the leaves of the majestic trees and offers the chance to invent ever-different situations. Flowers, benches and the irregular shapes of the trunks lend themselves perfectly to creating a romantic Romeo-and-Juliet atmosphere.
segments.Il sole si abbassava sull’orizzonte, e l: The sun was sinking towards the horizon, and the couple, energetic and enthusiastic about the experience and the places, showed no sign of tiredness. In any case, we allowed ourselves a break with a wine toast on the low wall of the old terrace in front of the medieval church. It was the perfect occasion for more interesting shots, both wide-angle and with longer focal lengths.
segments.Per me è stato difficile non continuare: It was hard for me to stop shooting and allow myself a moment of rest, because the sky was blazing with a deep orange that made every perspective interesting. We took one last walk through the surrounding old village, exploring new views and including in the frames a bridge, some houses, the rooftops and, of course, the panoramic view.
segments.Seduti su una panchina, quando il sole t: Sitting on a bench, as the sun barely touched the outline of the hills in the distance, we took the last photos with longer exposure times, trying to convey that sense of the fleetingness of time which, on a day like this and with such a kind, considerate and willing couple, really passed in a flash.
segments.Questa è la prima foto che ho scattato a: This is the first photo I took in St. Gallen right after arriving: I captured it from a bridge near my new rented home, and I consider it the most significant of my adventure. That's because it was the snow that welcomed us, and its abbey — rising before my eyes every day as the symbol of the city — shapes the perception of this place with its presence, giving it character and identity.
segments.La neve è anche compagna d’avventura: la: Snow is also a companion of adventure: you meet it on the mountains, in the streets, outside office windows. I decided to give the photo a postcard look because it represents my journey towards a place that from that moment on would become important to me. I moved here to work as a freelancer, and I am now settling in Switzerland.
segments.Durante il fine settimana, l’attività pr: At the weekend, people's favourite activity is going to the mountains, or at least to places where nature reigns unchallenged around the cities. In this article you'll find some of the excursions that left me with the most lasting impressions during my time here: you'll see the Rhine Falls, the city university with its ziggurat architecture and glass surfaces, the theatre that resembles it in style but is its opposite — made of concrete and windowless — the Scientist's mountain and other peaks nearby.
segments.A cominciare dalla prima: il Rheinfall è: Starting with the first: the Rheinfall is a waterfall on Europe's most important river, which breaks its continuity with its grandeur, plunging from one riverbed to a lower one through marvellous cascades. To take the photo, I ventured onto the tourist boat that explores the falls up close — a really fun experience. Along with me, my partner and our dog, there was a whole group of Buddhist monks in their orange robes, smiling like children and busy fiddling with their smartphones to bring home images to show in Tibet.
segments.Mi guardavano divertiti mentre ero sdrai: They watched me with amusement as I lay at the bow, soaked by the spray, my lens aimed like a sniper to get the shot.
segments.L’università, invece, con il suo caratte: The university, on the other hand, with its minimalist yet gentle character, blends perfectly with the sky, giving you the feeling of being in another city, not German-speaking, almost abroad but not quite.
segments.Eppure, la prima frase che ho sentito ap: And yet, the first sentence I heard upon arriving was: «Yes, mum, I ate everything, don't worry», spoken with a Neapolitan accent. In an instant I was back in Italy.

segments.La cima della montagna, dalla forma pira: The pyramid-shaped mountain top is unmistakable: once imprinted in your memory, you'll find yourself recognising it in numerous advertising campaigns and localised social media content.
segments.Dal basso, è imponente. Per questo ho de: From below, it is imposing. That's why I decided to take a close-up shot with my Sigma Art 85mm mounted on the Sony Alpha in HDR mode. The sharpness of the lens gave me an incredible level of detail — particularly impressive when viewing the photo in its original format, although even on the web the quality remains remarkable.
segments.Un sentiero ci ha condotti infine a un l: A path finally led us to an immense lake, framed by curious cows that let themselves be petted like lambs. They watched me with amused expressions as I dived into the icy water, with those shades of blue you only find in the high mountains.
